statement.zh: 教科文将杰内老城列入世界遗产，强调中尼日尔泥砖城市传统（UNESCO 116）。
statement.en: UNESCO lists Old Towns of Djenné as World Heritage, emphasizing Middle Niger mudbrick urban tradition (UNESCO 116).
